messages.author: a9fc767a51d12e9a
messages.subject: exact meaning of "Sample Correlation"
parts: Hi, I was wondering how exactly the correlation is computed by methylKit when running the function getCorrelation().  Between any 2 samples, is it calculating methylation correlation based on the CpGs that are common between the 2 samples, or in some other way?  Thank you, Rajat

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] exact meaning of "Sample Correlation"

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] exact meaning of "Sample Correlation"
parts:
by default (if you didn't change the default arguments) methylBase object contains only CpGs that are covered by all samples, so if sample A,B and C are in the object they can not have different number of CpGs. So, it depends which samples are in the methylBase object that is fed into getCorrelation()

Best,
Altuna
